Waymo Self Driving Taxi Goes Rogue: Blocks Traffic, Evades Capture | JJRicks Rides With Waymo #54

A confused Waymo self-driving taxi car was captured on video as it became stranded on an Arizona road earlier this month while carrying a passenger and then unexpectedly driving away as a worker from the company's roadside assistance arrived to help.
The Waymo vehicle repeatedly drove away from roadside assistance, dispatched within minutes of the car becoming stuck.
"While the situation was not ideal, the Waymo Driver operated the vehicle safely until roadside assistance arrived," the company said.
A couple of minutes into his Waymo ride, Robert Moreno said the cool feeling of getting an invitation to ride on a driverless vehicle quickly shifted.
A special thank you to Danny Harmon from @Distant Signal for the voiceover segment.
Waymo operates a limited ridehail service in Chandler, Arizona.
The Alphabet-owned company said it was an "unusual situation" and the taxi had operated safely throughout the journey.
Autonomous vehicle experts who reviewed the video footage of the 41-minute trip posted on YouTube by the Waymo passenger say it shows a series of gaffes by the Waymo self-driving technology.

The Alphabet-owned company said it was an "unusual situation" and the taxi had operated safely throughout the journey.
